name: 56542 · Fosston, MN
findings: ZIP 56542 (Fosston) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56542 (Fosston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56542 (Fosston) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.
